An image of a stone plaque with French text.
Describe the image for visually impaired users.

        *   Few sentences.
        *   Focus on foreground objects.
        *   Succinct and factual.
        *   No mention of lighting conditions.

    *   *Object:* A large stone plaque or wall inscription.
    *   *Material:* Appears to be light-colored stone (possibly limestone or marble) with carved/engraved letters.
    *   *Content:* French text in uppercase. It mentions "LE GOUVERNEMENT PROVISOIRE DE LA REPUBLIQUE FRANÇAISE," "LIBÉRATION," "VILLE DE PARIS," and "CHARLES DE GAULLE."
    *   *Setting:* It's an outdoor wall, possibly part of a monument. There's a concrete or stone ledge at the top.

    *   *Attempt 1:* A stone wall has a big plaque on it. It has a lot of words written in French in all capital letters. It mentions Paris and Charles de Gaulle. It's about the liberation of Paris.
    *   *Refining for conciseness and facts:* A large, rectangular stone plaque is mounted on a weathered wall. The surface is covered with several lines of engraved French text in all capital letters. The text mentions the liberation of Paris and is signed by Charles de Gaulle at the bottom right.
    *   *Final Polish:* A rectangular stone plaque is set into a wall, featuring several lines of engraved French text in all capital letters. The inscription commemorates the liberation of Paris and is signed "CHARLES DE GAULLE" at the bottom right.

semantics.value: Quote from the woman who submitted it to Little Free Library: "My husband built this library for my parents as a Christmas gift. Their neighbors have been coming to the door of their house for years to borrow books and we thought we'd make it easier on everybody by bringing the books outside! The library was built from scrap wood in our garage and even the screws were recycled from an old canoe my husband built years ago. My 3 children painted dragonflies to decorate the outside making it truly a gift from our whole family to my parents and their neighbors."
